scope: Bounded check of a nominal 100 kohm / 100 nF external RSTN ramp at a valid, stable 1.8 V logic supply. No CAD edits or complete reset/power-sequencing qualification.

recommended_operating_conditions.qualification: Do not describe this table as containing an explicit unlimited entry; it specifies no input-transition constraint.

characterized_Schmitt_input_evidence.example_limit: The 1.65 V entries are quoted only as direct evidence of characterized hysteresis; they are not substituted for exact 1.8 V switching thresholds or used to guarantee reset timing.

fast_edge_test_condition.interpretation: Propagation-delay measurement condition, not a recommended-operating input slew limit. The tabulated nanosecond delay limits are not a full guarantee of RC-generated reset timing.

manufacturer_interpretation.title: Nexperia Logic Application Handbook / Design Engineer's Guide
manufacturer_interpretation.location: FAQ, PDF page 130: What is the difference between a Schmitt Trigger and Schmitt Trigger Action input?; also section 6.2.3
manufacturer_interpretation.short_quote: There is no maximum input transition fall and rise rate to be obeyed (∆t/∆V).
manufacturer_interpretation.applicability: The handbook identifies true Schmitt inputs by specified VT+/VT- thresholds and distinguishes them from unquantified Schmitt-action inputs. The 97 Table 12 supplies those thresholds and hysteresis, while Table 7 supplies no conflicting transition limit.
manufacturer_interpretation.evidence_method: Official manufacturer PDF content read through web search; independent second review agrees. No restricted local-download retry.

contrast_with_06.parameter: Delta t / Delta V input transition rise and fall rate
contrast_with_06.application: The same RC must not directly drive the 06. Its existing direct gate-output drive from U92 is retained; actual valid-supply loading/edge verification and partial-power behavior remain separate checks.

conclusion: Manufacturer-specified Schmitt transfer characteristics, absence of a 97 transition restriction, and explicit manufacturer handbook guidance support the 10 ms nominal RC at the 97 input during valid stable-supply operation. This is a justified interpretation of the complete manufacturer evidence, not an invented unlimited row or footnote in Table 7.
not_qualified_by_this_check: Correct reset behavior during the logic supply ramp, especially below the 0.8 V recommended minimum
Guaranteed reset delay, pulse width, or release timing across resistor/capacitor tolerance, DC bias, temperature, leakage and actual threshold spread
Actual gate-output loading/edge rate into U93 and full thermal/power behavior
independent_review: A separate source review confirmed Table 7, Table 12, Table 10 and the handbook FAQ interpretation.
